findings.text: follow-on: EXPECTED_VECTOR_INDEX_FILTERS is read from the gitignored generated schema_context_data, and its ImportError fallback is an empty map, so on a checkout whose generated module predates the vector_index_filters annotation the expected property set is the embedding alone; ensure_vector_indexes then drops the correctly-registered live index and recreates it without the WITH clause, after which the always-rendered in-SEARCH predicate fails to plan. Regenerating via `uv run build-models --force` after merge closes it, and it is recorded at docs/evidence/fragments/jt60sa-discovery-completion/search-code-facility-prefilter.html#search-code-facility-prefilter-followon.

item_verdicts.diff: read 65c01fbbd..36ddec3e8 commit by commit (single commit 36ddec3e8); it adds prefilter_clauses to build_vector_search, a vector_index_filters schema annotation emitted by the generator into VECTOR_INDEX_FILTERS, and ensure_vector_indexes reconciliation against the live property set.
item_verdicts.done_when: each clause has an artifact: tests/llm/test_search_tools.py:824 pins the predicate inside SEARCH end to end; tests/graph/test_vector_search.py:106 pins the builder ordering; tests/graph/test_schema_context.py:199/212/248 pin the facility filter annotation, the unchanged 3-tuple vector_indexes and 2-tuple generated VECTOR_INDEXES, the DDL WITH clause and the recreation on a filter mismatch; head-gate.log records 678 passed, 10 skipped, EXIT=0.
item_verdicts.goal: the node goal is that search_code selects vector candidates inside the facility through a filter property registered on the code-chunk index so a small facility's chunks survive the ANN cut; imas_codex/llm/search_tools.py:1523 pushes `cc.facility_id = $facility` into prefilter_clauses and imas_codex/graph/vector_search.py:70 renders it as a WHERE between FOR and LIMIT inside SEARCH.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; status complete, baseline_suite (65c01fbbd, EXIT=0, 663 passed) and after_suite (36ddec3e8, EXIT=0, 678 passed) name run-dir logs, and negative_control_log names a red run.
item_verdicts.write_paths: read the manifest's eleven declared paths and the diff; every changed path (imas_codex/schemas/facility.yaml, imas_codex/graph/schema.py, scripts/gen_schema_context.py, imas_codex/graph/client.py, imas_codex/graph/vector_search.py, imas_codex/llm/search_tools.py, the three test files, the evidence fragment and the figure) lies inside them.

justifications.durability: negative-control.log reds tests/llm/test_search_tools.py:838 when the predicate is moved back outside SEARCH, and tests/graph/test_schema_context.py:224 asserts against the literal `WITH [n.facility_id]` and the drop name; docked because no test pins the 'signal search unchanged' clause beyond the diff not reaching it.
justifications.evidence: head-gate.log records 678 passed, 10 skipped, EXIT=0 against base-gate.log's 663 passed at 65c01fbbd, and negative-control.log is red at EXIT=1; docked because the head log carries no revision/tree/command header while the base log does, so its provenance rests on the new test names it lists rather than on its own first lines.
justifications.fit: the change extends build_vector_search and ensure_vector_indexes in place, commit 36ddec3e8 carries a conventional subject and a body, and the new _slot_annotation helper at imas_codex/graph/schema.py:210 follows the file's existing local-import idiom; no forbidden name appears.
justifications.goal_fidelity: imas_codex/llm/search_tools.py:1523 renders `cc.facility_id = $facility` inside SEARCH through imas_codex/graph/vector_search.py:70, and live-selene-query.log shows _search_code's own output returning three /analysis/src/SAselene_v2.0_forPSRC/eqequb.f chunks in the top ten at default k.
justifications.reuse: it extends the single owner of SEARCH-clause construction (imas_codex/graph/vector_search.py:16) and the single owner of index creation (imas_codex/graph/client.py:89) and forks no capability; a search over imas_codex/graph and imas_codex/llm found no second facility-prefilter or filter-registration mechanism.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff 65c01fbbd..36ddec3e8 touches exactly the eleven declared paths and nothing outside them.
